downloadSteps.title: Download Steps
downloadSteps.s2: Paste a valid video URL and select the download destination.
downloadSteps.s4: Navigate to the "Downloading" or "All Downloads" status page.
downloadSteps.s5: Wait for the video metadata to be processed.
downloadSteps.s6: Once ready, click the play button in the status section.
downloadSteps.s8: After completion, right-click on the entry for additional options. You can:
downloadSteps.s9: Click on a row to view detailed information about your download.
downloadSteps.s10: Your download logs will be saved for future reference in the history.

pauseStop.title: Pausing, Stopping, Removing and Starting downloads
pauseStop.s1: Each download has control buttons on the status columns and the context menu
pauseStop.s1a: Play button - Starts or resumes the download
pauseStop.s1b: Pause button - Temporarily pauses the download
pauseStop.s1c: Stop button - Completely stops and removes the download
pauseStop.s2: Download control buttons are also available within the task bar and task dropdown
pauseStop.s2a: Users can select multiple downloads to either play or stop
pauseStop.s2b: Users may also use the all option to control all currently downloading videos
pauseStop.s3a: Removing downloads affects currently finished downloads. This action deletes the downloaded file from your device and removes the record from history.
pauseStop.s3b: For pending downloads, only the download record is saved; no file has been saved to the drive yet.

whatIsHistory.title: What is History
whatIsHistory.s1: History is a record of all your past downloads
whatIsHistory.s2a: Doesn't show download progress or controls
whatIsHistory.s2b: Only keeps track of what you've downloaded
whatIsHistory.s2c: Shows if files still exist on your device
whatIsHistory.s3: You can use History to redownload videos or check your past downloads

viewVideos.title: How to view videos
viewVideos.s1: Right-click a video row in status pages to open the context menu and access the video view

contextMenus.title: How to use context menus
contextMenus.s1: Right-click any download to access additional options:

stuckInitializing.title: Download is stuck in initializing
stuckInitializing.s2: Verify the video URL is still valid
stuckInitializing.s3b: Go to the folder and delete any lingering part file

failedDelete.title: Failed to delete video
failedDelete.s1: If you can't delete a video:
failedDelete.s1a: Close any applications using the video file
failedDelete.s1c: Check if you have permission to delete files in that location

slowSpeed.title: Download speed is slow
slowSpeed.s1b: Reduce the number of simultaneous downloads
slowSpeed.s1c: Adjust the speed limit in settings if enabled

whatIsAfda.title: What is Article Fetcher
whatIsAfda.s1: Article Fetcher finds and saves article content from news and blog websites.
whatIsAfda.s2a: Single article download — paste one article URL and download it immediately.
whatIsAfda.s2b: Website subscription — add a news site and have new articles downloaded automatically on a schedule.
whatIsAfda.s3: Articles are saved as DOCX files to a folder of your choice.

singleArticle.title: Downloading a Single Article
singleArticle.s1: Paste an article URL into the search bar at the top of the app.
singleArticle.s2: Article Fetcher detects the URL as an article automatically.
singleArticle.s3: Click the Article Installer button (document icon) that appears.
singleArticle.s4: Choose a save folder if prompted.
singleArticle.s5: The article is downloaded and saved as a DOCX file.

websiteSubscription.title: Setting Up a Website Subscription
websiteSubscription.s1: Navigate to the Article Fetcher section from the sidebar.
websiteSubscription.s2: Click "Add Website" to open the setup modal.
websiteSubscription.s3: Paste the URL of the news or blog website.
websiteSubscription.s4: Wait for the frequency analysis to complete — it detects how often the site publishes.
websiteSubscription.s5a: Interval — Every 15 minutes, Every 1 hour, Every 6 hours, or Daily.
websiteSubscription.s5b: Category — News, Sports, Technology, and more.
websiteSubscription.s5c: Save folder — choose where downloaded articles are stored.
websiteSubscription.s6: Click Confirm — the website is added and monitoring begins.

managingSubscriptions.title: Managing Your Subscriptions
managingSubscriptions.s1: Pause or resume a subscription from the context menu or the subscription detail page.
managingSubscriptions.s2: Edit the check interval, category, or save folder from the Settings tab inside the subscription detail.
managingSubscriptions.s3: Delete a subscription from the context menu — this removes monitoring but does not delete already-downloaded files.
managingSubscriptions.s4: View per-subscription download history from the Downloads tab.
managingSubscriptions.s5: View check history and activity from the Activity Log tab.

howToAdd.title: How to Add a Subscription
howToAdd.s1: Navigate to the Subscription section from the sidebar.
howToAdd.s2: Click the Subscribe button to open the subscription modal.
howToAdd.s3: Paste a YouTube channel URL into the source URL field.
howToAdd.s3a: Must be a channel or playlist URL — not a single video or Shorts link.
howToAdd.s3b: Only YouTube channels are supported at this time.
howToAdd.s4: Wait for the channel analysis to finish — it detects the channel's upload pattern automatically.
howToAdd.s5: Once the analysis completes, configure your subscription:
howToAdd.s5a: Auto — uses the detected upload pattern to set the check schedule.
howToAdd.s5b: Manual — choose specific days of the week, a check time, and timezone.
howToAdd.s5c: Select a quality preset (Lowest, Low, or Best).
howToAdd.s5d: Choose a save-to folder for downloaded videos.
howToAdd.s6: Set how many of the channel's existing videos to download on the first run using the "Download last N videos" dropdown.
howToAdd.s7: Click Subscribe to confirm — the subscription is queued and processed in the background.

whatHappensAfter.title: What Happens After Subscribing
whatHappensAfter.s1: The subscription is queued and set up in the background — you'll see it appear in the Subscription list.
whatHappensAfter.s2: On the first run, Subscription downloads the most recent videos up to the limit you selected.
whatHappensAfter.s3: After the initial scrape, Subscription automatically checks for new uploads on your configured schedule (daily, weekly, or as detected).
whatHappensAfter.s4: Any newly detected videos are added to the download queue and processed like regular downloads.
whatHappensAfter.s5: You can view activity, download history, and analytics for each subscription from its detail page.
whatHappensAfter.s6: Subscriptions can be paused, edited, or deleted at any time from the context menu or the subscription settings tab.

invalidUrl.title: Invalid URL / Unsupported protocol
invalidUrl.s1: Make sure the URL starts with https://.
invalidUrl.s2: Copy the URL directly from the browser address bar.

unsupportedPlatform.title: Unsupported platform
unsupportedPlatform.s1: Only YouTube channel URLs are currently supported.
unsupportedPlatform.s2: URLs from other platforms will not pass validation.

videoOrShorts.title: Video or Shorts link detected
videoOrShorts.s1: Subscription subscribes to channels, not individual videos.
videoOrShorts.s2: Use the main download feature for single video URLs.
videoOrShorts.s3: For a channel, navigate to the channel page and copy its URL.

alreadySubscribed.title: Already subscribed
alreadySubscribed.s1: A subscription for this channel already exists.
alreadySubscribed.s2: Find and manage it from the Subscription list.

noVideos.title: No videos found / Channel appears empty
noVideos.s1: The channel may only have Shorts — try the channel's main videos tab URL.
noVideos.s2: The channel may be private or have no public uploads.

analysisFailed.title: Analysis failed
analysisFailed.s2: The channel URL may have changed — verify it in your browser.
analysisFailed.s3: Restart the app and try again if the error persists.
